title: Augmentation compatibility of the canonical base-localization map
statement: Let R, Rp, A, B and D be commutative rings with the compatible algebra structures and scalar towers of [lem-pc-base-localization-map], and Rp a localization of R at S. Fix a degree i, an A-complex Q, base-derived tensor cohomology models L over R and K over Rp, and a D-linear isomorphism e of their extended cohomology satisfying IsBaseLocalizationMap. For any ordinary-complex isomorphism tau between their extensions of Q to D that sends every d tensor x to d tensor x, the square of localized comparison maps commutes: L.localizedComparison followed by H(tau) equals e followed by K.localizedComparison.

proof.text:
/-- Compatibility of the characterized map with localized augmentation.
Source: Stacks Project, Tags 0DJ8 and 06Y6.
(blueprint: lem-pc-base-localization-comparison).

Proof: the universal lift defining baseLocalizationDerivedMap satisfies its
counit equation by leftDerived_fac. Apply it to the restricted complex Q and
then cohomology. The ordinary tensor identification fixes b tensor x.
Combine this identity with both comparison_eq equations to identify the
ordinary comparison maps. Transpose by extension/restriction adjunction and
use localized_eq on both models. On a generator 1 tensor x, the resulting
D-linear square is exactly the formula defining IsBaseLocalizationMap.
Every ordinary complex identification tau satisfying the specified formula
coincides with the canonical identification: tensor induction proves equality
of its degree-j maps, and complex extensionality proves equality of chain
maps. Tensor induction likewise proves the D-linear square from its generators.
This proof uses neither invertibility of the comparison maps nor flatness
of D. Zero complexes and zero coefficient rings give the unique zero maps. -/ The generator-level calculation is supplied by the auxiliary theorem; the remaining extension-of-scalars hom extensionality and the IsBaseLocalizationMap equation are proved directly.

lean.statement: theorem baseLocalization_comparison (S : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization S Rp] (i : ℤ) (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D) (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel Rp A B Q D) (e : (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).obj (L.cohomology i) ≅ (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[Rp] B) D)).obj (K.cohomology i)) (he : IsBaseLocalizationMap R Rp B A D S Q L K i e.hom) (τ : ((ModuleCat.extendScalars ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q ≅ ((ModuleCat.extendScalars ((algebraMap (A ⊗[Rp] B) D).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[Rp] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) (hτ : ∀ (j : ℤ) (d : D) (x : Q.X j), τ.hom.f j (d ⊗ₜ[A,(algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))] x) = d ⊗ₜ[A,(algebraMap (A ⊗[Rp] B) D).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[Rp] B))] x) : L.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap τ.hom i = e.hom ≫ K.localizedComparison i
